# Version 4.150.0
> **Skia m150 and new filters** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 upgrades to Skia m150 and adds image filter, color filter, and fast-bounds APIs. This release also caches the SKSurface canvas wrapper, fixes small-sigma raster blurs, and updates HarfBuzz to 14.2.1. Remaining pre-v4 obsoletes are now compile errors, and .NET Interactive support has been removed.

## Breaking Changes

- **Remaining pre-v4 obsolete members are now compile errors** — SKPaint text and font members and obsolete enum values now produce compile errors. Move text sizing and typeface configuration to SKFont and remove references to the obsolete enum values. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))
- **.NET Interactive support removed** — The SkiaSharp integration for .NET Interactive and Polyglot Notebooks has been removed. Use the standard SkiaSharp NuGet packages in a supported notebook environment or remain on an earlier release. ([#4186](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4186))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m150** — The bundled rendering engine moves to chrome/m150 and includes a subsequent upstream bug-fix sync. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146), [#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))
- **HarfBuzz updated to 14.2.1** — The bundled text-shaping engine picks up the HarfBuzz 14.2.1 maintenance update. ([#4167](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4167))

## API Surface

- **SKPaint.GetFastBounds() supports quick-reject culling** — The new method calculates conservative paint bounds so callers can reject invisible draws efficiently. ([#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))
- **SKImageFilter gains CreateCrop() and CreateEmpty()** — New factories crop image filter output or create an empty image filter for filter-graph composition. ([#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228))
- **SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw() visualizes overdraw** — The new color filter maps overdraw counts to colors for diagnosing rendering hotspots. ([#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227))

## Bug Fixes

- **Small-sigma raster blurs corrected** — Small blur radii once again use the correct raster pipeline path instead of producing regressed output. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKSurface caches its Canvas wrapper** — Repeated Canvas access now reuses the managed wrapper, avoiding recurring allocations in rendering loops. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz library to 14.2.1; the HarfBuzzSharp binding has no API changes in this release.
